photoA.prompt: Produce ONE clean standalone photorealistic interior photograph of the lamps shown in the attached section mockup, to be used as the photographic resource inside two illustrative advertisements. Closely match just the lamp interior in the mockup, not the UI. A warm brown/plaster wall, sculptural light-wood dome pendant hanging at upper right, a cream cylindrical textured shade table lamp on a light speckled stone cylindrical base near the center, glowing softly. Both lamps clearly visible. Wood dining table across the lower quarter, dark wood/leather chair at lower left, stack of two books and shallow wooden bowl at lower right, amber brown ceramic vase with leafy branches at far right. Warm directional window light, natural leaf shadows on the left wall, calm editorial product photograph, realistic wood grain and stone. Square framing, balanced composition; the main lamps are within the central area so both remain recognizable in portrait and landscape crops. Leave darker quiet wall space at upper left for HTML typography. No people. Absolutely NO typography, words, logos, frames, badges, buttons, interface, watermark, or graphic marks. Output only the photograph, edge to edge.

photoB.prompt: Make a LANDSCAPE 3:2 photographic version of this exact clean lamp interior for the lower photo area of an advertisement. Pendant sits above-right of the table lamp. Add only natural continuation of the existing wall and table at left/right if necessary. Keep the same editorial natural photo quality. No people. No typography, logos, UI, labels, border or watermark. Output only the photograph, edge to edge.
